scope: Original source geometry study; maximum exterior fidelity and geographic registration are pending

references.facts: Built tall tower: 320.4 m tip, 301.1 m occupied height, 80 floors; curved connecting skybridge with 3 m deep triangular trusses. Excludes the cancelled taller proposal.

references.observations: Official diagram distinguishes the tall Tower 2, shorter Tower 1 and level-41 connection. These are hotel floor labels, not continuous physical-storey numbers. Room photograph confirms divided glazing.

Level-6 plan, tower/podium section, north-arrow site plan and public frontage photographs inspected. Text separates an eight-storey podium from 72- and 36-storey towers. Working envelope and tower offsets are reconstructed and not approved as measured floor polygons.
Exterior photograph inspected for blue glazing, silver bands, rounded corners, open curved crowns, broad louvred refuge bands and exposed bridge trusses. No photograph is embedded in the geometry.
